description.value: The Whistler Grocery Store has operated as an anchor business in purpose-built Whistler Village since January 1981, making it one of the most enduring locally owned institutions in the resort. Named Canadian Independent Grocer of the Year in 2002 and a repeat Award of Merit recipient from the Canadian Federation of Independent Grocers, it stocks local and international products across a wide range of dietary needs. The store also operates the Delish Café and offers small-scale catering including picnic and hiking lunches, handy for cyclists planning a day in the backcountry.
